a: ဒဏ္ဍယတိ(ကြိ)

ဒဏ်-ထား-တပ်-ပေး-၏။ အပြစ်ဒဏ်ပေး၏ ညှဉ်းဆဲ-နှိပ်စက်-ဖျက်ဆီး-၏။ ဒဏေ္ဍတိ-（က）-ကြည့်။

DOP: daṇḍeti, ~ayati daṇḍiyati pr. 3 sg. [ S. daṇḍayati], punishes ; Dhātup 570 (daṇḍa daṇḍane); Dhātum 799 (daḍi āṇāyaṃ); Ja IV 192, 10* (adaṇḍiyaṃ ~ayati daṇḍiyaṃ ca adaṇḍiyaṃ, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se ~iyati; 193, 2´ foll. : yo adaṇḍiyaṃ adaṇḍapaṇetabbaṃ ca ~etvā daṇḍiyaṃ ca daṇḍapaṇetabbaṃ adaṇḍetvā attano rucim eva karoti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee yo adaṇḍetabbaṃ daṇḍeti daṇḍetabbaṃ ca daṇḍiyaṃ adaṇḍetvā); 495, 14* (aparādhake … rājāno ~enti); 495, 15* (na maccuno ~ayitussahanti; 498, 24´ : te pi maccuṃ ~ayituṃ na sakkonti); Mil 84, 19 (taṃ mayaṃ diguṇaṃ ~emā ti); Pj II 63, 27 (kāyaduccaritaṃ hi ~ayatī ti daṇḍo, bādheti anayavyasanaṃ pāpetī ti vuttaṃ hoti); Sadd 533, 26 (daṇḍa daṇḍavinipāte: ~eti ~ayati daṇḍo); — neg. part.pr. adaṇḍiya(t), mfn. , Ja IV 192, 10* (daṇḍiyaṃ ca adaṇḍiyaṃ); — absol. daṇḍetvā, Ja IV 193, 2´ ( Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ~eti); — neg. adaṇḍetvā, Ja IV 193, 3´ ; — pass. part.pr. daṇḍīyanta, mfn. , Saddh 187 (caṇḍehi Yama-dūtehi ~īyanto punappunaṃ); — pp daṇḍita , mfn. [ ts ], punished; fined ; Vin IV 224, 8 (so puriso ~o, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr daṇḍiko); Ja I 234, 22 (sattavāre raññā ~o); — fpp ( a ) daṇḍiya, mfn. , Ja IV 192, 10* ; Mhv 37:5 (Mahāvihāravāsissa āhāraṃ deti bhikkhuno yo so sataṃ daṇḍiyo ti); — neg. adaṇḍiya, mfn. , Ja IV 192, 10* ; ( b ) daṇḍetabba, mfn. , Ja IV 193, 3´ (daṇḍetabbaṃ, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se daṇḍapaṇetabbaṃ); Mil 186, 8 (daṇḍetabbo, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se daṇḍitabbo); — see also daṇḍanīya; — caus. pr. 3 sg. daṇḍāpeti , Ja I 483, 21 (taṃ … aṭṭhakahāpaṇe ~essāmī ti); Mp II 144, 9 (~essāma); — aor. 3 pl. daṇḍāpesuṃ, Vin IV 224, 8 (mahāmattā taṃ purisaṃ ~āpesuṃ).
